title: Spartan GT Matte Black

specs.material: Carbon Fiber Composite Shell with ABS Impact Liner
specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

technical_analysis: Features Carbon-On-Skin composite structure with CFD aerodynamic wind-tunnel tuned rear spoiler profile paired with Autoseal visor mechanism pressing the shield onto the helmet gasket for rain and sound insulation. The interior utilizes Bamboo fiber eco-friendly lining with EasyFit glasses grooves for riders wearing spectacles with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Shark Spartan GT Matte Black: combining France 🇫🇷 craftsmanship with Autoseal visor mechanism pressing the shield onto the helmet gasket for rain and sound insulation and Bamboo fiber eco-friendly lining with EasyFit glasses grooves for riders wearing spectacles. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Shark Spartan GT Matte Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes with pressure-relief temple channels and contoured removable cheek pads.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in

qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Shark Spartan GT Matte Black is a benchmark Commuter Full Face helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.

qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

description: The Shark Spartan GT Matte Black is crafted for daily urban navigators conquering dense traffic, delivering responsive balance and confident road feel. Featuring a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan architecture at a featherweight 1286g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across ECE 22.06, DOT FMVSS 218 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~85 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with a glove-friendly quick-release ratcheting buckle.
yoast_title: Shark Spartan GT Matte Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
introduction: Positioned in Shark's Full Face lineup, the Spartan GT Matte Black brings French engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06, DOT FMVSS 218 track safety.
story:
The Shark Spartan GT Matte Black represents Shark's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~85 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Shark Spartan GT Matte Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
